item.name: Set the vectorization opt-in flag for a pipeline.

request.name: Set the vectorization opt-in flag for a pipeline.

description.content:
Set the vectorization opt-in flag for a pipeline (vectorization-spec-v4 / LD13).
Semantics:
  - `null` or omitted, or `false` → the pipeline does not vectorize;
    its loads are byte-identical to a pipeline created before this
    feature existed.
  - `true` → subsequent loads of datasets in this pipeline produce
    per-row embeddings (IBM Granite-30M, 384-dim) landed in
    `<destination_database>.<pipeline-name>.PRETEXT` on the
    pipeline's destination, in addition to the normal writer output.

Flipping the flag is **not retroactive**. See the `vectorize` field on the `pipeline` schema for the full semantics.
Setting `true` is only valid on Snowflake-family destinations (LD15); attempts on any other destination are rejected with 400.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
